{{WotQ|{{PAGENAME}}}}

The '''Old Blood''' is a phenomena in which traits from one's heritage manifest themselves in oneself. It is frequently used to explain certain characteristics exhibited by the people of the [[Two Rivers]].

== Ancestral ==

The exact nature of the Old Blood phenomena is not entirely clear. As the text of the books usually uses it in relation to descendants of [[Manetheren]], it most likely describes the persistence of traits that hearken back to one's ancestors,{{ref/book|c|Old Tongue}} as [[Thom Merrilin]] suggests,{{ref/book|1|19}} possibly with some connection to the "purity" of one's bloodlines,{{ref/book|1|47}} since the Two Rivers population is highly isolated prior to the events of the last few years before the [[Last Battle]]. The phenomena might be linked to the concept of [[Reincarnation|rebirth]] and past lives, but is almost certainly not simply past lives manifesting in some way.{{ref/book|1|19}}

== Effects ==

The Old Blood manifests most visibly in [[Mat Cauthon]] who, even before receiving the memories of various dead men at [[Rhuidean]], frequently uses [[Old Tongue]] words or phrases despite having never learned the Old Tongue by conventional means.{{ref/book|1|18}}{{ref/book|5|22}} Moreover, he also demonstrates some level of knowledge or memory of ancient Manetheren up to and including specific events, most notably while being [[Healing|Healed]] of his connection to the [[ruby-hilted dagger]] for the third and final time.{{ref/book|3|18}}

The Old Blood is used to explain the prevalence and strength of Two Rivers residents who can channel.{{ref/book|1|12}}{{ref/book|1|13}}{{ref/book|4|31}}

== Familiarity ==

In the text, the term is almost always used by [[Aes Sedai]] (notably including [[Moiraine Damodred]],{{ref/book|1|12}} [[Siuan Sanche]],{{ref/book|3|18}} [[Verin Mathwin]],{{ref/book|3|18}} and [[Alanna Mosvani]]{{ref/book|4|31}}) or people who learned the concept from Aes Sedai.{{ref/book|4|28}}{{ref/book|5|22}}{{ref/book|7|21}} [[Birgitte Silverbow]] demonstrates prior familiarity in the final reference to the concept, when Mat Cauthon broaches the subject with her.{{ref/book|7|21}} [[Thom Merrilin]] has some vague familiarity with the concept expressed after Moiraine raises the possibility, but seems to be expressing a (now-discarded) doubt that it was a real phenomena.{{ref/book|1|19}} Thom's comment implies that familiarity with the concept is somewhat common, at least among higher levels of society, but that the concept is likely thought fanciful by most who lack arcane knowledge.

== Origin ==

Moiraine suggests that "Old Blood" is blood "descended from the Age of Legends."{{ref/book|2|8}}

== Trivia ==

* The term "Old Blood" is never capitalized, except for all three references to it following Mat's healing in [[Tar Valon]]{{ref/book|5|22}} and in the {{c}} entry for [[Egwene]].{{ref/book|c|Egwene al'Vere}} Notably, it is not capitalized in the other three Companion entries which reference it.{{ref/book|c|Arad}}{{ref/book|c|Hearne}}{{ref/book|c|Old Tongue}}
